svg.aria-label: Isometric illustration for Expertise. A product lies flat like a pop-up book, its screen divided into six cards. Six fields rise out of them: finance as a bank card, health as a first-aid box, energy as a wind turbine, learning as a graduation cap on a book, retail as a shopping bag with handles and a price tag, and property, which lifts off on a lime card with a house and its own product screen. A solid blue Tcules designer leans in and works on it.
